notes: analysis is an optional metadata block; every analysis.* field remains optional even when the analysis block itself is present. Deliberately excluded from analysis: per-EVD independence (relational — use analysis.lineage_id plus the current (transitional, legacy-ASM-owned) evidence_confidence.independence field), directness (assessed per-problem via the current transitional ASM fields instead), and COVERAGE-GAP / LOW-DIGITAL-LEVERAGE as contribution values (these are research/assessment findings, not atomic evidence). contribution includes PLANNED-SOLUTION, distinct from EXISTING-SOLUTION: EXISTING-SOLUTION means an operating/delivered solution or service already exists; PLANNED-SOLUTION means a formally planned/committed/in-delivery response that is not yet established as operating and available to the affected journey. Neither value implies effectiveness — whether a solution (existing or planned) actually closes the gap is currently a transitional ASM-level remaining_gap question, not an EVD contribution. Target ownership of these synthesis concepts is defined in docs/datamodel.md, not here.
